title: GORGO: Online Tuning for Cross-Region Network-Aware LLM Serving
event_hint: Proxy architecture that jointly tunes network latency, prefill cost, and queueing delay for cross-region LLM serving, improving p95 TTFT and E2E latency double-digit percent over baselines; releases ART-Chat-2.5M dataset.
problem: LLM inference services increasingly proxy client requests to engine replicas distributed globally. Load-balancing policies must jointly consider KV-cache locality, replica load, and variable network latency to optimize latency and TTFT, but existing systems evaluate only a subset of these factors, causing uneven load and KV-cache distribution. Existing datasets also lack long-context, high prefix-reuse data needed to evaluate such systems.
mechanism: GORGO is a proxy architecture that holistically factors network latency, prefill cost, and queueing delay using tunable parameters. Evolutionary strategies on a tuning window derived from a synthetic dataset (ART-Chat-2.5M, built from long-context production metadata) guide GORGO's parameters to optimize p95 TTFT. Parameters are learned offline then held fixed during evaluation.

evidence.claim: GORGO improves p95 TTFT by 6.9-15.5% over baseline policies during held-out evaluation windows with fixed learned parameters.
evidence.condition: held-out evaluation window, fixed learned parameters

evidence.claim: GORGO improves p95 end-to-end latency by 14.3-30.9% over the same baselines.
Releases ART-Chat-2.5M, a synthetic dataset derived from long-context production metadata, because existing datasets lack long-context, high prefix-reuse data.
Uses evolutionary strategies on a tuning window from ART-Chat-2.5M to guide GORGO's parameters to optimize p95 TTFT.
GORGO holistically factors network latency, prefill cost, and queueing delay using tunable parameters.

evaluation_context: Cross-region LLM serving proxy; baselines include simple session affinity and prefix-cache policies; synthetic ART-Chat-2.5M dataset from long-context production metadata; evolutionary-strategy tuning; held-out evaluation with fixed learned params.
limitations: Evaluation uses a synthetic dataset (ART-Chat-2.5M) rather than direct live traffic; abstract-level, full traffic patterns and generalization across providers require full text. Code/dataset released (CC BY 4.0) but not inspected here. Full body not fetched.
project_relevance: Directly relevant to cross-region and KVCache concerns: it jointly optimizes KV-cache locality, network latency, and queueing delay in geographically distributed LLM serving, exactly the cross-region/KV-cache-routing problem space. The holistic latency+locality tuning and the released prefix-reuse dataset are actionable for multi-region serving and KVCache transfer scheduling.
